page.layout: Top: two engraved coin medallions side by side, each with its legend around the rim (left DIONYSIVS, right PALLADON V.M.). Below them, one column of running text, two paragraphs. Below the text, an ornament with no printed words.

main_text.p: DIONYSIVS, Hammonis filius,armis sumptis Rheam & Camesenuum regno paterno pellens,& secū Osirim horum filium retinens, in filiumque suum adoptans , eum de nomine patris sui Hammonem Jovem cognominauit, uti à magistro Olympo Olympicum ,eique totius Aegypti regnum tradidit, anno ab orbe condito 1948.ante Christum natum 2014. post nouem annos Barzanes Sabatij filius in Armenia à Nino supe-ratur. Videto Berosum lib.5.

PALLADON virgo, à Græcis dicta Minerva, anno 43. regni Nini(de quo supra mētionem feci)apud Tritonidem lacum infantula expofita est:atq; ab eodē Dionysio, Jove etiam Libyco cognominato,adoptata in filiam:hæc omnem militiam prima Libycos docuit. Hæc item(secundum alios qui eandem Palladem vocant)lanificium antea incognitum invenit,& docuit,& textrinū officium:hinc lanifices,fullones,tinctores,textricésque puellæ eam pro Dea coluere. dicitur præterea usum olei invenisse ac docuisse:& numeros deniq; ipsos,quadrigas, atque arma.Bero.lib.5.Supple.Chro.

page.notes: The coin legends are engraved in the medallions; "V.M." on the right coin may carry marks I could not separate from the rim, so it is read as printed in the image. The date "1948" and "2014" are printed with spaces between the digits in the scan; I copied them as one number. The "5" after "lib." appears in old form and is read as 5. The ornament below the text carries no words.
